main.remarks: Functional specialization. Registered via Tool.RegisterCommand and invoked via Tool.ExecuteCommand. Commands that inherit the public execution methods use the structured template: the Command owns registration, task tracking, terminal result application, logging, and cleanup. A derived type that overrides a public execution method bypasses these guarantees and owns the complete execution lifecycle. Long-running asynchronous tasks are tracked via Activities.

method.name: CreateCanceledResult
method.summary: Creates the terminal result used when command core execution throws an OperationCanceledException.
method.param: Activity whose timeout state determines cancellation classification.
method.returns: A Canceled or TimedOut result containing the original exception.
method.remarks: The default implementation classifies the result as TimedOut when returns true; otherwise it classifies the result as Canceled.

method.name: CreateFaultedResult
method.summary: Creates the terminal result used when command core execution throws an unexpected exception.
method.returns: A Faulted result containing the original exception.

method.name: ExecuteCore
method.summary: Performs synchronous command work and returns its structured terminal result.
method.param: Optional command key supplied for execution.
method.remarks: Override this method when synchronous execution is enabled. The base execution template translates OperationCanceledException and unexpected exceptions, publishes requested output, sets the ActivityRecord, logs the outcome, and performs cleanup. This hook does not fall back to ExecuteCoreAsync.
method.exception: The command has not implemented synchronous core execution.

method.name: ExecuteCoreAsync
method.summary: Performs asynchronous command work and returns its structured terminal result.
method.param: Optional command key supplied for execution.
method.returns: A value task that produces the terminal result.
method.remarks: Override this method when asynchronous or free-mode execution is enabled. The tracked runner translates OperationCanceledException and unexpected exceptions, publishes requested output, sets the ActivityRecord, logs the outcome, and performs cleanup. This hook does not fall back to ExecuteCore.
method.exception: The command has not implemented asynchronous core execution.

method.name: ApplyResult
method.summary: Publishes requested output, atomically applies the terminal ActivityRecord with publication state, and logs the resulting disposition.
method.param: Structured result produced or translated by the execution pipeline.
method.returns: The result actually applied to the Activity.
method.remarks: expresses publication intent. The applied is true only when AddOutput succeeds, including when the stored payload is null. If publication of requested output fails for a successful result, the applied result is converted to Failed so success is not reported without its promised output.

method.name: CleanUpTemplate
method.summary: Routes execution cleanup according to Activity free-mode ownership and contains cleanup failures.
method.remarks: A cleanup exception is preserved as a Faulted terminal record only when no terminal record has already been published, and is otherwise limited to fault logging.

method.name: GetCanceledResult
method.summary: Safely obtains the command-specific canceled or timed-out result.
method.param: Activity whose timeout state is evaluated.
method.returns: The customized result, or a default no-output Canceled or TimedOut fallback if customization fails.

method.name: GetFaultedResult
method.summary: Safely obtains the command-specific faulted result.
method.returns: The customized result, or a default no-output Faulted fallback if customization fails.

method.name: LogResult
method.summary: Dispatches terminal result logging by ActivityRecordCode without allowing logging failures to escape the template.

method.name: RunTrackedCoreAsync
method.summary: Runs asynchronous command core work under task ownership, translates exceptions, applies the terminal result, and performs cleanup.
method.param: Activity that owns and exposes the tracked runner.
Optional command key supplied for execution.
Start gate indicating whether the runner was installed as the Activity task.
method.returns: A task whose result is the applied CommandResult.
method.remarks: The start gate prevents core work from beginning before Activity.Task ownership is established. All core cancellation and faults are translated so the tracked task completes without an unobserved exception.

method.name: TryBeginExecution
method.summary: Claims command-template lifecycle ownership and registers an unused Activity before core work starts.
method.returns: True when lifecycle ownership and registration succeed; otherwise false.
method.remarks: An Activity that already has a terminal record, already has a task, or has already been claimed is rejected. Registration failure is translated to a Faulted result and triggers template cleanup.

method.name: AddActivity
method.returns: True if Activity added to Attached Tool.

method.name: AddOutput
method.returns: True if Output added to Attached Tool.

method.name: CleanUp
method.summary: Clean up an Activity when the tool owns the lifecycle (Activity.FreeMode is false).

method.name: CleanUpFreeMode
method.summary: Clean up an Activity in free mode when the command owns the lifecycle.

method.name: EnabledAllowed
method.returns: True if the command is enabled and access is granted.

method.name: RemoveActivity
method.returns: True if Activity removed from Attached Tool.

method.name: SetCanceled
method.summary: Set Activity as Canceled (or TimedOut, determined by ).
